hunks.baseline: The Jin Family’s Spear Technique consisted of seven forms in total. The final form, Sky-Piercing Strike, smashed into the steel dummy.
hunks.sol: The Jin Family’s Spear Technique consisted of seven forms. The last of them, Sky-Piercing Strike, smashed into the steel dummy.

hunks.baseline: With a deafening crash, the steel dummy’s chest caved in and it slammed into the wall. As I withdrew my spear, Jin Mukyung’s voice reached my ears.
hunks.sol: With a deafening crash, the dummy’s chest caved in and it slammed into the wall. As I drew back my spear, Jin Mukyung’s voice reached my ears.

hunks.baseline: “The Jin Family’s Manoeuvre Technique is similar.”
hunks.sol: “The Jin Family’s Manoeuvre Technique is about the same.”

hunks.baseline: Wait. Had I ever told him what martial arts I had learned?
hunks.sol: Wait. Had I ever told him which martial arts I had learned?

hunks.baseline: As I searched my memory, Jin Mukyung gave a quiet laugh.
hunks.sol: As I searched my memory, Jin Mukyung let out a quiet laugh.

hunks.baseline: He muttered under his breath and nodded, then suddenly came to his senses.
hunks.sol: He muttered under his breath and nodded, then suddenly caught himself.

hunks.baseline: “Ahem. There was a more important reason than that.”
hunks.sol: “Ahem. There was a more important reason.”

hunks.baseline: “There was nothing left for me to learn in our family.”
hunks.sol: “There were no martial arts left for me to learn in our family.”

hunks.baseline: *I’ve learned several different weapons, too, but…*
hunks.sol: *I’ve learned to use several different weapons, too, but…*

hunks.baseline: My situation was completely different from Jin Mukyung’s. That had not been martial arts. It had been a desperate struggle to survive my battles with monsters.
hunks.sol: My situation was completely different from Jin Mukyung’s. What I had done could hardly be called martial arts. It had been a desperate struggle to survive my battles with monsters.

hunks.baseline: Focusing on just one thing was already difficult enough.
hunks.sol: Mastering even one weapon was hard enough.

hunks.baseline: After casually warming up with a few movements of his hands, he spoke in a quiet voice.
“Let’s try this.”
hunks.sol: He flexed his hands for a moment to warm up, then murmured, “Let’s try it like this.”

hunks.baseline: His legs crossed rapidly. A flash shot out right after and slammed into the steel dummy’s chest.
hunks.sol: His feet crossed in a blur. A flash followed, slamming into the steel dummy’s chest.

hunks.baseline: For a moment, I could not speak. Then I remembered something I had temporarily forgotten.
hunks.sol: For a moment, I could not speak. Then I remembered something I had briefly forgotten.

hunks.baseline: Jin Mukyung was a genius. An ordinary person might struggle just to finish a bowl of plain rice, but Jin Mukyung could digest an eight-dish spread without trouble.
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung was a genius. An ordinary person might struggle to finish a single bowl of plain rice, but Jin Mukyung could digest an eight-dish spread without trouble.

hunks.baseline: With just a few simple changes to the movements, he had transformed the Jin Family’s Spear Technique into a sword technique.
hunks.sol: By adding and removing just a few simple movements, he had transformed the Jin Family’s Spear Technique into a sword technique.

hunks.baseline: He truly was a genius of martial arts. The rumors had not been exaggerated.
hunks.sol: A genius of martial arts. The rumors had not been exaggerated in the slightest.

hunks.baseline: The move he had just shown me had probably been no more than the tip of the iceberg. A chill ran down my spine.
hunks.sol: The move he had just shown me was probably no more than the tip of the iceberg. The thought sent a chill down my spine.

hunks.baseline: I only came to my senses when I heard his cold voice.
hunks.sol: His cold voice snapped me back to my senses.

hunks.baseline: “Your hyung went to the trouble of giving you a demonstration, and you dare look away?”
hunks.sol: “Your big brother went to the trouble of giving you a demonstration, and you dare let your mind wander?”

hunks.baseline: My vision flashed. Jin Mukyung watched me suffer with satisfaction before speaking again.
hunks.sol: My vision flashed. Jin Mukyung watched my suffering with satisfaction before speaking again.

hunks.baseline: “I forgot because of you!”
hunks.sol: “You made me forget!”

hunks.baseline: “You don’t understand very well when things are explained verbally. It’s faster for you to experience them with your body.”
hunks.sol: “You don’t understand when things are explained in words. It’ll be faster for you to experience them firsthand.”

hunks.baseline: “There’s no such thing as ‘wait a moment’ in real combat. Would you say that to someone who came to kill you? ‘I’m nervous, so I’ll go take a piss first.’ Would you expect him to say, ‘Then go take a shit, too’?”
hunks.sol: “There’s no ‘wait a moment’ in real combat. Would you say that to someone who came to kill you? ‘I’m nervous, so I need to take a piss first.’ Do you think he’d tell you to go take a shit while you’re at it?”

hunks.baseline: “We’re sparring right now!”
hunks.sol: “We’re only sparring right now!”

hunks.baseline: “Huh? You’re using informal speech again. You’re dead.”
hunks.sol: “Huh? Informal speech again. You’re dead.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Mukyung gripped his wooden sword tightly and charged at me like a leopard.
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung tightened his grip on his wooden sword and charged at me like a leopard.

hunks.baseline: I launched myself away without waiting to see what happened.
hunks.sol: I threw myself aside without waiting to see what happened.

hunks.baseline: Leaving the bone-rattling crash behind me, I snatched a wooden practice spear from the rack. An ominous voice followed me.
hunks.sol: Leaving the bone-rattling crash behind me, I snatched a wooden practice spear from the rack. An ominous voice followed close behind.

hunks.baseline: “From now on, I’ll teach you a lesson.”
hunks.sol: “Allow me to begin your lesson.”

hunks.baseline: The sound of the air being torn apart was anything but ordinary. I turned and swung my spear at the same time, but I was already too late. The faintly upturned corner of Jin Mukyung’s mouth was right in front of me.
hunks.sol: The sound of air tearing was anything but ordinary. I turned and swung my spear at the same time, but I was already too late. Jin Mukyung’s faintly upturned lips were right in front of me.

hunks.baseline: Through my shaking vision, Jin Mukyung’s voice continued.
hunks.sol: Through my wavering vision, Jin Mukyung’s voice continued.

hunks.baseline: “When fighting someone more skilled than yourself, be cautious.”
hunks.sol: “When fighting someone stronger than you, be cautious.”

hunks.baseline: The next moment, Jin Mukyung’s palm struck my chest. With a bang like a bursting balloon, I flew backward and slid all the way into the wall.
hunks.sol: The next moment, Jin Mukyung’s palm struck my chest. With a bang like a bursting balloon, I flew backward and slid all the way to the wall.

hunks.baseline: My organs did not spill out with a mouthful of blood. When I lifted my head, I saw Jin Mukyung slowly walking toward me.
hunks.sol: My organs did not spill out along with a mouthful of blood. When I lifted my head, I saw Jin Mukyung slowly walking toward me.

hunks.baseline: “You’re such a coward. Did you really think your hyung would use internal energy against his younger brother?”
hunks.sol: “You scared little brat. Did you really think your hyung would use internal energy against his younger brother?”

hunks.baseline: “I can’t. The feel of hitting things is better with this.”
hunks.sol: “I can’t. It feels better to hit you with this.”

hunks.baseline: The smile disappeared from Jin Mukyung’s face. I was afraid of what he’d do to me later, but that was a problem for later. Right now, I wanted to beat the bastard in front of me somehow.
hunks.sol: The smile vanished from Jin Mukyung’s face. I was afraid of what he might do to me later, but that was a problem for later. Right now, I wanted to beat the bastard in front of me somehow.

hunks.baseline: “I don’t really know what that means… but it’s really pissing me off.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t know exactly what that means… but it’s really pissing me off.”

hunks.baseline: The moment I finished speaking, Jin Mukyung rushed toward me. His movements were noticeably rougher than before. I knocked aside the wooden sword descending toward my shoulder with the shaft of my spear.
hunks.sol: The instant I finished speaking, Jin Mukyung rushed at me. His movements were noticeably rougher than before. I knocked aside the wooden sword descending toward my shoulder with the shaft of my spear.

hunks.baseline: *Did they coat this wooden sword with glue?*
hunks.sol: *Did he coat that wooden sword in glue?*

hunks.baseline: I needed to widen the distance, but the sword would not come away. It wrapped around my spear shaft like a snake and stabbed inward.
hunks.sol: I needed to open up some distance, but the sword would not come away. It coiled around my spear shaft like a snake and thrust toward me.

hunks.baseline: “What else would it be? The Jin Family’s Spear Technique. No, the Jin Sword Technique.”
hunks.sol: “What else? The Jin Family’s Spear Technique. No, the Jin Sword Technique.”

hunks.baseline: “Second. Never forget that while you were drinking your ass off with women, I was training until I was covered in blood and sweat.”
hunks.sol: “Second. Never forget that while you were drinking yourself stupid with women, I was training in blood and sweat.”

hunks.baseline: The pain was secondary to the wave of fury that surged through me.
hunks.sol: The pain was nothing compared to the fury surging through me.

hunks.baseline: *While everyone else was holding their girlfriends’ hands and going on dates for Christmas, I was having a group date with monsters in a Gate, you fucking bastard!*
hunks.sol: *While everyone else was holding hands with their girlfriends and going on Christmas dates, I was having a group date with monsters in a Gate, you fucking bastard!*

hunks.baseline: The wooden sword pounded my thigh and forearm in succession, but I felt nothing. My anger had overwhelmed the pain.
hunks.sol: The wooden sword pounded my thigh and forearm in quick succession, but I felt nothing. My anger had overwhelmed the pain.

hunks.baseline: I gritted my teeth and sent my spear flying in every direction.
hunks.sol: I gritted my teeth and unleashed a flurry of spear strikes.

hunks.baseline: Under my sharp offensive, Jin Mukyung began to retreat little by little. Combat was all about momentum. My instincts, honed through countless real battles, whispered to me.
hunks.sol: Under the sharp assault, Jin Mukyung began to give ground little by little. Combat was all about momentum. My instincts, honed through countless real battles, whispered to me.

hunks.baseline: The crash was loud enough to leave my ears ringing. But the attack had not landed properly.
hunks.sol: The crash was loud enough to leave my ears ringing. But the attack had not landed.

hunks.baseline: With a triumphant grin, I thrust one fist toward his abdomen.
hunks.sol: With a triumphant grin, I drove my fist toward his abdomen.

hunks.baseline: *It’s a feint, you bastard!*
hunks.sol: *It was a feint, you bastard!*

hunks.baseline: When you were standing this close, martial arts did not matter. One punch to the solar plexus, and not even a Peak master’s grandfather would stand a chance.
hunks.sol: At this distance, martial arts did not matter. One punch to the solar plexus, and not even a Peak master’s grandfather would stand a chance.

hunks.baseline: I was confused for only a moment before a scream burst out.
hunks.sol: My confusion lasted only a moment before a scream burst out.

hunks.baseline: Through my pain-filled vision, I saw Jin Mukyung shyly lifting his shirt. A bulging leather vest beneath his martial arts uniform came into view.
hunks.sol: Through my pain-blurred vision, I saw Jin Mukyung bashfully lift his shirt. A bulging leather vest appeared beneath his martial arts uniform.

hunks.baseline: A bulletproof vest? No, it was not one. But it looked like it could stop bullets. Every pocket in the leather vest had been packed full of iron ingots.
hunks.sol: A bulletproof vest? No. But it looked like it could stop bullets. Every pocket in the leather vest had been crammed full of iron ingots.

hunks.baseline: Jin Mukyung pulled a dented iron ingot from one of the pockets near his solar plexus. My fistprint was clearly visible.
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung pulled a dented iron ingot from a pocket near his solar plexus. My fistprint was clearly visible.

hunks.baseline: Martial arts? Forms? There was no more of that nonsense. I threw off the awkward appearance of a martial artist and returned to being a Hunter with seven years of experience.
hunks.sol: Martial arts? Forms? To hell with all that. I cast off the awkward guise of a martial artist and returned to being a Hunter with seven years of experience.

hunks.baseline: With all my strength, I kicked Jin Mukyung in the shin as he grinned triumphantly. It was a decisive technique known as a soccer kick, or simply a shin-kick.
hunks.sol: With all my strength, I kicked Jin Mukyung in the shin as he grinned triumphantly. It was a deadly technique known as a soccer kick—or simply a shin-kick.

hunks.baseline: I had never seen anyone stay fine after taking one of these.
hunks.sol: I had never seen anyone take one of these and remain standing.

hunks.baseline: Add one more to the list.
hunks.sol: Now I had.

hunks.baseline: Jin Mukyung looked down at me as I collapsed, clutching my foot. His expression seemed to say that I was the most pathetic person alive.
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung looked down at me as I collapsed, clutching my foot. His expression said he had never seen anyone so pathetic.

hunks.baseline: “Fifth… Never mind. Talking is exhausting.”
hunks.sol: “Fifth… Never mind. I’m getting tired of talking.”

hunks.baseline: He pulled a flat metal plate from beneath his pant leg and strode toward me. I tried to stand, limping, but he kicked my ankle and made me sit back down.
hunks.sol: He pulled a flat metal plate from beneath his pant leg and strode toward me. I tried to limp to my feet, but he kicked my ankle out from under me and sent me back down.

hunks.baseline: If I used Inventory, I might have a chance to turn things around, but I did not want to blatantly do something that would obviously make him suspicious. I lowered my head with a sigh.
hunks.sol: If I used Inventory, I might have a chance to turn things around, but I did not want to do something so blatantly suspicious right in front of him. I lowered my head with a sigh.

hunks.baseline: I lifted my head at his hard voice. Jin Mukyung’s face had gone cold.
hunks.sol: I looked up at the hardness in his voice. Jin Mukyung’s face had gone cold.

hunks.baseline: The man who had been grinning and enthusiastically beating me only moments ago was nowhere to be seen.
hunks.sol: The man who had been grinning as he gleefully beat me only moments ago was nowhere to be seen.

hunks.baseline: His emotionless gaze made my skin prickle, and my Adam’s apple bobbed.
hunks.sol: His emotionless gaze made my skin prickle. My Adam’s apple bobbed.

hunks.baseline: With a thud, my arm bent uselessly and I lost my balance.
hunks.sol: My arm buckled with a thud, throwing me off balance.

hunks.baseline: Jin Mukyung did not care. He swung the wooden sword again. The Jin Mukyung standing before me now seemed unable to hear the voice of the defeated.
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung ignored me and swung the wooden sword again. The Jin Mukyung standing before me now seemed unable to hear the voice of the defeated.

hunks.baseline: “You just had all four limbs cut off. By a vicious Peak master of the dark path who is several times stronger than you.”
hunks.sol: “You just had all four limbs cut off by a vicious Peak master of the dark path several times stronger than you.”

hunks.baseline: “If he were even nastier, there would be other methods, too.”
hunks.sol: “If he were even nastier, he’d have other methods.”

hunks.baseline: The moment Jin Mukyung’s hand blurred, my entire body stiffened and my tongue curled up. The System immediately announced the abnormal condition.
hunks.sol: The instant Jin Mukyung’s hand blurred, my entire body went rigid and my tongue curled back. The System immediately alerted me to the abnormal conditions.

hunks.baseline:
> **System**
>
> - The **Paralysis Acupoint** has been subdued. You will be paralyzed for two hours!
>
> - The **Mute Acupoint** has been subdued. You will be unable to make a sound for two hours!
hunks.sol:
> **System**
>
> - Your **Paralysis Acupoint** has been struck. You will be paralyzed for two hours!
>
> - Your **Mute Acupoint** has been struck. You will be unable to make a sound for two hours!

hunks.baseline: I could not move even a hair, and I could not speak.
hunks.sol: I could not move so much as a hair or make a single sound.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: The curses circled only inside my head and could not escape my lips. All I could do was glare at him. Jin Mukyung calmly met my furious gaze.
hunks.sol: The curses could only circle inside my head, unable to escape my lips. All I could do was glare at him. Jin Mukyung calmly met my furious gaze.

hunks.baseline: “Tendon-Splitting and Bone-Twisting is a cruel technique. Within an hour at most, your qi and blood will twist and all the bones in your body will be crushed. Even if you miraculously survive, you’ll either become a madman or live the rest of your life crippled.”
hunks.sol: “Tendon-Splitting and Bone-Twisting is a cruel technique. Within an hour at most, your qi and blood will twist and every bone in your body will be crushed. Even if you miraculously survive, you’ll either go insane or spend the rest of your life crippled.”

hunks.baseline: “Do you think you could endure that pain? You’d probably forget who you are within fifteen minutes.”
hunks.sol: “Do you think you could endure that pain? You’d probably forget who you were within fifteen minutes.”

hunks.baseline: A quiet voice accompanied something cold touching my throat. It was the metal plate Jin Mukyung had pulled out earlier. Its thin, sharp edge slowly pressed into my flesh.
hunks.sol: Something cold touched my throat as he spoke in a low voice. It was the metal plate Jin Mukyung had pulled out earlier. Its thin, sharp edge slowly dug into my flesh.

hunks.baseline: *Die? Like this?*
hunks.sol: *I’m going to die? Like this?*

hunks.baseline: I had survived dozens of brushes with death. In Gates, and in Murim. I had struggled all this time to survive somehow…
hunks.sol: I had survived dozens of brushes with death. In Gates and in Murim. I had struggled all this time to stay alive somehow…

hunks.baseline: To a so-called biological older brother who did not share a single drop of blood with me!
hunks.sol: Killed by the bastard who was supposed to be my biological older brother, even though we did not share a single drop of blood!

hunks.baseline: My body rigid, I stared only at the ceiling. Then the voice of the Reaper reached my ears.
hunks.sol: My body rigid, I could only stare at the ceiling as the voice of the Reaper reached my ears.

hunks.baseline: The strength drained from my entire body. I felt hot blood trickling down my neck.
hunks.sol: The strength drained from my entire body. I felt hot blood trickle down my neck.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung. Aged twenty-seven. Gone to sleep in Murim.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung. Aged twenty-seven. Laid to rest in Murim.

hunks.baseline: *I was hit at an acupoint, but I closed my eyes?*
hunks.sol: *My acupoints were sealed, but I just closed my eyes?*

hunks.baseline: At Jin Mukyung’s voice, I slowly opened my eyes. All five of my senses were sharp and clear, proof that I was alive.
hunks.sol: At Jin Mukyung’s voice, I slowly opened my eyes. All five of my senses were sharp and clear, proving that I was alive.

hunks.baseline: I hurriedly felt the back of my neck. The cut stung, and blood came away on my fingers, but there were only a few drops of it. Everything had been an illusion brought on by the fear and tension of death.
hunks.sol: I hurriedly felt my neck. The cut stung, and blood came away on my fingers, but it amounted to only a few drops. Everything else had been an illusion brought on by my terror of death and the unbearable tension.
